note: A mark showing which syllable in a word receives the main stress; in phonetics, also stress-mark notation.

senses.m: A mark showing which syllable in a word receives the main stress
senses.pat: place the stress mark · primary stress mark · stress-mark symbol
ex: The dictionary uses a stress mark before the emphasized syllable.
Từ điển dùng dấu trọng âm trước âm tiết được nhấn.
Students added stress marks to the pronunciation guide.
Học sinh thêm dấu trọng âm vào hướng dẫn phát âm.

note: A narrow tie or necktie made from a thin cord or string; style and usage vary.

senses.m: A narrow tie or necktie made from a thin cord or string
senses.pat: wear a string tie · a bolo-style string tie · a black string tie
ex: He wore a string tie with his western shirt.
Anh đeo cà vạt dây với áo kiểu miền Tây.
The costume included a braided string tie.
Bộ trang phục có cà vạt dây bện.

note: A poker game in which players remove an item of clothing when they lose a hand; adult, informal context.

senses.m: A poker game in which players remove an item of clothing when they lose a hand
senses.pat: play strip poker · a game of strip poker · strip-poker scene
ex: The film includes a brief scene of strip poker.
Bộ phim có một cảnh ngắn chơi poker cởi đồ.
They decided the party game was not appropriate for the event.
Họ quyết định trò chơi đó không phù hợp với sự kiện.

note: An organization representing students at a university; in some countries, also a building with student services.

senses.m: An organization representing students at a university
senses.pat: join the student union · student-union election · student union building
ex: The student union organized a campaign for safer cycling.
Hội sinh viên tổ chức chiến dịch đi xe đạp an toàn hơn.
The café is inside the student union building.
Quán cà phê nằm trong tòa nhà hội sinh viên.

note: A person considered pompous, overly formal, or self-important; informal and disparaging.

senses.m: A person considered pompous, overly formal, or self-important
senses.pat: a pompous stuffed shirt · call someone a stuffed shirt · act like a stuffed shirt
ex: The staff saw the new manager as a stuffed shirt.
Nhân viên cho rằng quản lý mới là người tự phụ, cứng nhắc.
He sounded like a stuffed shirt during the interview.
Anh nghe có vẻ tự phụ và quá kiểu cách trong buổi phỏng vấn.

note: A small bowl used to hold sugar, especially at a table.

senses.m: A small bowl used to hold sugar, especially at a table
senses.pat: a porcelain sugar bowl · pass the sugar bowl · fill the sugar bowl
ex: She put the sugar bowl beside the teapot.
Cô đặt hũ đường cạnh ấm trà.
The sugar bowl has a matching lid and spoon.
Hũ đường có nắp và thìa đồng bộ.

note: An open deck or platform on a ship or building where people can sit in the sun.

senses.m: An open deck or platform on a ship or building where people can sit in the sun
senses.pat: relax on the sun deck · ship’s sun deck · upper sun deck
ex: Passengers relaxed on the sun deck.
Hành khách thư giãn trên boong tắm nắng.
The hotel added loungers to its rooftop sun deck.
Khách sạn đặt thêm ghế nằm trên sân thượng tắm nắng.

note: Of an egg fried on one side so the yolk remains visible and usually runny; hyphenated as an adjective.

senses.m: Of an egg fried on one side so the yolk remains visible and usually runny
senses.pat: order eggs sunny-side up · cook an egg sunny-side up · sunny-side-up eggs
ex: He ordered two eggs sunny-side up.
Anh gọi hai quả trứng ốp la chỉ chiên một mặt.
The cook served the eggs sunny-side up with toast.
Đầu bếp phục vụ trứng ốp la lòng đào cùng bánh mì nướng.

note: A deity or ultimate divine power, especially in some philosophical or religious contexts; interpretation differs by tradition.

senses.m: A deity or ultimate divine power, especially in some philosophical or religious contexts
senses.pat: belief in a supreme being · a supreme being created · concept of the Supreme Being
ex: The text discusses belief in a supreme being.
Văn bản bàn về niềm tin vào một đấng tối cao.
Different traditions describe the Supreme Being in different ways.
Các truyền thống khác nhau mô tả Đấng Tối cao theo những cách khác nhau.

note: Postal items transported mainly by land or sea rather than air; delivery is usually slower.

senses.m: Postal items transported mainly by land or sea rather than air
senses.pat: send a parcel by surface mail · surface-mail delivery · surface mail rates
ex: The package was sent by surface mail to reduce the cost.
Gói hàng được gửi bằng đường bộ/đường biển để giảm chi phí.
Surface mail may take several weeks.
Thư gửi bằng đường bộ hoặc đường biển có thể mất vài tuần.

note: A public swimming pool or bathing facility; British and historical usage, with swimming pool now more common.

senses.m: A public swimming pool or bathing facility
senses.pat: a municipal swimming bath · visit the swimming baths · indoor swimming bath
ex: The town’s swimming baths reopened after repairs.
Nhà tắm công cộng có bể bơi của thị trấn mở cửa lại sau sửa chữa.
The old swimming bath is now a community center.
Nhà tắm có bể bơi cũ nay là trung tâm cộng đồng.

note: A close-fitting cap worn while swimming, often to keep hair contained or reduce drag; not a complete barrier to water.

senses.pat: wear a swimming cap · put on a swimming cap · silicone swimming cap
ex: Swimmers must wear a swimming cap in the pool.
Người bơi phải đội mũ bơi trong hồ.
A swimming cap can help keep long hair out of the face.
Mũ bơi giúp tóc dài không xòa vào mặt.

note: A garment worn for swimming; British English, also swimsuit.

senses.m: A garment worn for swimming
senses.pat: put on a swimming costume · a one-piece swimming costume · swimming-costume design
ex: She packed a swimming costume for the holiday.
Cô mang theo đồ bơi cho kỳ nghỉ.
The shop sells swimming costumes in several sizes.
Cửa hàng bán đồ bơi với nhiều kích cỡ.

note: A constructed pool of water for swimming, exercise, or recreation.

senses.m: A constructed pool of water for swimming, exercise, or recreation
senses.pat: an indoor/outdoor swimming pool · swim in the pool · swimming-pool lane
ex: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
Khách sạn có hồ bơi ngoài trời.
The swimming pool is closed for maintenance.
Hồ bơi đóng cửa để bảo trì.

note: Short garments worn by men or boys for swimming; styles vary.

senses.m: Short garments worn by men or boys for swimming
senses.pat: a pair of swimming trunks · put on swimming trunks · swim in trunks
ex: He changed into his swimming trunks at the beach.
Anh thay quần bơi ở bãi biển.
The shop stocks swimming trunks for children.
Cửa hàng có bán quần bơi cho trẻ em.

note: A door that swings open in either direction, often returning automatically to a closed position.

senses.m: A door that swings open in either direction, often returning automatically to a closed position
senses.pat: push through a swing door · a kitchen swing door · swing-door hinge
ex: The waiter pushed through the swing door into the kitchen.
Người phục vụ đẩy cánh cửa hai chiều để vào bếp.
A spring hinge keeps the swing door closed.
Bản lề lò xo giúp cửa hai chiều tự đóng.

note: To change from one system, method, or channel to another.

senses.m: To change from one system, method, or channel to another
senses.pat: switch over to a new system · switch over from gas to electric · switch over channels

Gia đình chuyển sang gói năng lượng rẻ hơn.
Switch over to channel five for the live broadcast.
Chuyển sang kênh năm để xem truyền hình trực tiếp.

note: A beef steak cut across the T-shaped bone, which separates tenderloin and strip portions; spelling varies as T-bone.

senses.m: A beef steak cut across the T-shaped bone, which separates tenderloin and strip portions
senses.pat: grill a T-bone steak · a thick T-bone · order T-bone steak
ex: He grilled a T-bone steak for dinner.
Anh nướng bít tết T-bone cho bữa tối.
The butcher cut a thick T-bone from the loin.
Người bán thịt cắt một miếng T-bone dày từ phần thăn.

note: A lamp designed to stand on a table or desk, usually with a base and shade.

senses.m: A lamp designed to stand on a table or desk, usually with a base and shade
senses.pat: switch on a table lamp · bedside table lamp · a ceramic table lamp
ex: A table lamp lit the corner of the room.
Đèn bàn chiếu sáng góc phòng.
She chose a small table lamp for her desk.
Cô chọn một chiếc đèn bàn nhỏ cho bàn làm việc.

note: A racket sport played on a table divided by a net; also called ping-pong.

senses.m: A racket sport played on a table divided by a net
senses.pat: play table tennis · table-tennis tournament · table-tennis racket
ex: They play table tennis during lunch breaks.
Họ chơi bóng bàn trong giờ nghỉ trưa.
The school hosted a table-tennis tournament.
Trường tổ chức giải bóng bàn.
